data_quality_notes: WebFetch was egress-blocked for the entirety of this run: every URL returned HTTP 403, including neutral control hosts example.com and en.wikipedia.org. This is an environment network-policy block, not a portal-specific bot wall.
PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp, SRX, Trovit and PropertyGiant search and listing pages could not be opened/verified live this run.

WebSearch (a separate channel) returned index snippets only. Per the non-negotiable 'real link only' rule, a snippet without a live-verified canonical URL is not sufficient to publish a listing, so no listing is shown.
No listing has been fabricated, guessed, or carried over from the 2026-06-06 baseline.
